data.name: Query_DemandStatus
data.value:
Select * from ( Select distinct case when Issued < 0 then (Requested + Issued ) else (Requested - Issued ) end as Balance,* From ( Select distinct detCC.CostCenterName as DetailCostCenter,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID ,ItemAlias.InventoryItemStatusCode AS InventoryItemStatusCode, SET_OperatingUnit.LogoImage, Set_Department.DepartmentName As Department, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName As CostCenter, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo As StockRequisitionNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate As Date, Set_Location.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, (Case when INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 then 'Approved' when INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 5 then 'InProcess' when INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 13 then 'PartiallyApproved' when INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 14 then 'Discuss' END) AS CurrentStatus, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName As Category, ItemAlias.ItemID As ItemID, ItemAlias.Description As ItemDescription, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName As UOM ,Tab.Remarks ,Tab.TransactionQuantity As Requested, Datediff(d, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DueDate) As DapsLaps, ( Select isnull(Sum(GINDetail.TransactionQuantity), 0) from INV_StockTransactionDetail GINDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader As GINHeader On GINHeader.StockTransactionID = GINDetail.StockTransactionID and GINHeader.CompanyID = GINDetail.CompanyId and GINHeader.PeriodID = GINDetail.PeriodID and GINHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GINHeader.DocumentTypeID and GINHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyId and GINHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Where GINDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And GINDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And GINDetail.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'GIN%' AND GINHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND GINDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And GINDetail.SourceCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND GINDetail.SourceHeaderID = Tab.StockTransactionID AND GINDetail.SourceLineID = Tab.TransactionDetailID ) As Issued, ( Select IsNull(Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End), 0) As Issued From INV_StockTransactionHeader inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 inner Join INV_Item On INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --And INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_Item.Status = 1 Where DocumentType like 'GIN%' AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.ITEMID = ItemAlias.ItemID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID ) As ForBalance,
( select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INV_Item.Status = 1 where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = ItemAlias.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) As TotalOnRequest, IsNull( ( select sum(RcvQty) PendingPOs from ( select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity - isnull( ( Select IsNull(Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else sd.TransactionQuantity End), 0) from INV_StockTransactionDetail sd inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = sd.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = sd.CompanyId and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = sd.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = sd.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = sd.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = sd.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = sd.PeriodID AND sd.Status = 1 ), 0) as RcvQty FROM AP_PurchaseOrderDetail INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ClosedCode Is Null and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = ItemAlias.ItemID ) X ), 0) as PendingPOs ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DueDate as Req_DueDate , CAST(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PODueDate as Date) as DueDate
,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PONos
,tab.StockTransactionID,tab.TransactionDetailID
From INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID And Set_CostCenter.Status = 1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail As Tab ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = Tab.StockTransactionID And Tab.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Tab.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Tab.Status = 1 left join Set_CostCenter detCC On detCC.CostCenterID = Tab.CostCenterID And detCC.Status = 1
left Join Set_UnitOfMeasure ON Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = Tab.TransactionUOMID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitID = SET_Company.OperatingUnitID LEFT JOIN Set_Location ON Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID left join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition on AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.RequisitionHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.RequisitionDetailID = tab.TransactionDetailID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo left join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = tab.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = tab.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item ItemAlias On ItemAlias.ItemID = tab.ItemID And ItemAlias.CompanyID = Tab.CompanyID And ItemAlias.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = ItemAlias.ItemTypeID --And INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = ItemAlias.CompanyID
Where DocumentType like 'Requisition%' and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyId = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {4} {3} {1}{2}
)tab ) Tab1 -- where Tab1.Balance > 0 {5} Order By Tab1.InventoryItemStatusCode -------------------------
select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber As PONos, Cast(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PODueDate As Date) As DueDate, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity - isnull( ( Select IsNull(Sum( case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else sd.TransactionQuantity End ),0)
from INV_StockTransactionDetail sd inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON (INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = sd.StockTransactionID) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = sd.CompanyId and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = sd.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = sd.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = sd.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = sd.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = sd.PeriodID AND sd.Status = 1 ), 0) as BalanceQuantity FROM AP_PurchaseOrderDetail INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ClosedCode Is Null --and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = ItemAlias.ItemID ------------------------------------- SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo As StockRequisitionNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status, SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID, SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator, ASPNET_Users.UserName as ApprovalUser, LastApproval.UserName As LastApprovedBy FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader inner JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND CAST(SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo as int) = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = ( SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND CAST(SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo as int) = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND Status = 1 ) left JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT sth.TotalAmount FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT sth.TotalAmount FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup = INV_Item.ApprovalItemGroupID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup IS NULL) left JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 left join aspnet_users on Set_ApprovalAuthority.UserID = Aspnet_Users.UserID left join aspnet_users LastApproval on LastApproval.UserID = SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedBy Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND DocumentType like 'GIN%' {3} Order By SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel desc
SELECT aspnet_users.username FROM aspnet_users INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy = aspnet_users.userid INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Requisition' --WHERE {0}

data.name: Query_DemandStatusItemWise
data.value:
Select * from ( Select distinct case when Issued < 0 then (Requested + Issued ) else (Requested - Issued ) end as Balance,* From ( Select distinct detCC.CostCenterName as DetailCostCenter,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID ,ItemAlias.InventoryItemStatusCode AS InventoryItemStatusCode, SET_OperatingUnit.LogoImage, Set_Department.DepartmentName As Department, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName As CostCenter, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo As StockRequisitionNo, Set_Department.DepartmentID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate As Date, Set_Location.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, (Case when INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 then 'Approved' when INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 5 then 'InProcess' when INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 13 then 'PartiallyApproved' when INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 14 then 'Discuss' END) AS CurrentStatus, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName As Category, ItemAlias.ItemID As ItemID, ItemAlias.Description As ItemDescription, Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName As UOM ,Tab.Remarks ,Tab.TransactionQuantity As Requested, Datediff(d, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DueDate) As DapsLaps, ( Select isnull(Sum(GINDetail.TransactionQuantity), 0) from INV_StockTransactionDetail GINDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader As GINHeader On GINHeader.StockTransactionID = GINDetail.StockTransactionID and GINHeader.CompanyID = GINDetail.CompanyId and GINHeader.PeriodID = GINDetail.PeriodID and GINHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GINHeader.DocumentTypeID and GINHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyId and GINHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Where GINDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And GINDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And GINDetail.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'GIN%' AND GINHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND GINDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And GINDetail.SourceCode = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND GINDetail.SourceHeaderID = Tab.StockTransactionID AND GINDetail.SourceLineID = Tab.TransactionDetailID ) As Issued, ( Select IsNull(Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity End), 0) As Issued From INV_StockTransactionHeader inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 inner Join INV_Item On INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --And INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_Item.Status = 1 Where DocumentType like 'GIN%' AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.ITEMID = ItemAlias.ItemID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID ) As ForBalance,
( select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID And INV_Item.Status = 1 where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = ItemAlias.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) As TotalOnRequest, IsNull( ( select sum(RcvQty) PendingPOs from ( select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity - isnull( ( Select IsNull(Sum(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else sd.TransactionQuantity End), 0) from INV_StockTransactionDetail sd inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = sd.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = sd.CompanyId and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = sd.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = sd.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = sd.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = sd.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = sd.PeriodID AND sd.Status = 1 ), 0) as RcvQty FROM AP_PurchaseOrderDetail INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ClosedCode Is Null and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = ItemAlias.ItemID ) X ), 0) as PendingPOs ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DueDate as Req_DueDate , CAST(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PODueDate as Date) as DueDate
,AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PONos
,tab.StockTransactionID,tab.TransactionDetailID
From INV_StockTransactionHeader Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterID And Set_CostCenter.Status = 1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail As Tab ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = Tab.StockTransactionID And Tab.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Tab.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Tab.Status = 1 left join Set_CostCenter detCC On detCC.CostCenterID = Tab.CostCenterID And detCC.Status = 1
left Join Set_UnitOfMeasure ON Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = Tab.TransactionUOMID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitID = SET_Company.OperatingUnitID LEFT JOIN Set_Location ON Set_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID left join AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition on AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.RequisitionHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.RequisitionDetailID = tab.TransactionDetailID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo left join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderRequisition.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = tab.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = tab.PeriodID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_Item ItemAlias On ItemAlias.ItemID = tab.ItemID And ItemAlias.CompanyID = Tab.CompanyID And ItemAlias.Status = 1
Inner Join INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = ItemAlias.ItemTypeID --And INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = ItemAlias.CompanyID
Where DocumentType like 'Requisition%' and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyId = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {4} {3} {1}{2}
)tab ) Tab1 -- where Tab1.Balance > 0 {5} Order By Tab1.InventoryItemStatusCode -------------------------
select AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber As PONos, Cast(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PODueDate As Date) As DueDate, AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Quantity - isnull( ( Select IsNull(Sum( case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else sd.TransactionQuantity End ),0)
from INV_StockTransactionDetail sd inner join INV_StockTransactionHeader ON (INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = sd.StockTransactionID) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = sd.CompanyId and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = sd.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = sd.SourceHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PODetailID = sd.SourceLineID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = sd.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = sd.PeriodID AND sd.Status = 1 ), 0) as BalanceQuantity FROM AP_PurchaseOrderDetail INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.POHeaderID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.ClosedCode Is Null --and AP_PurchaseOrderDetail.ItemID = ItemAlias.ItemID ------------------------------------- SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo As StockRequisitionNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status, SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel, SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID, SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator, ASPNET_Users.UserName as ApprovalUser, LastApproval.UserName As LastApprovedBy FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader inner JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND CAST(SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo as int) = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = ( SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND CAST(SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo as int) = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND Status = 1 ) left JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedBy OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.UserID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT sth.TotalAmount FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT sth.TotalAmount FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup = INV_Item.ApprovalItemGroupID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup IS NULL) left JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 left join aspnet_users on Set_ApprovalAuthority.UserID = Aspnet_Users.UserID left join aspnet_users LastApproval on LastApproval.UserID = SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedBy Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND DocumentType like 'GIN%' {3} Order By SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel desc

Req_DueDate , CAST(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PODueDate as Date) as DueDate --, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber as PONos

INV_StockTransactionHeader sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = sth WHERE sth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup = INV_Item.ApprovalItemGroupID OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalItemGroup IS NULL) left JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.Status = 1 left join aspnet_users on Set_ApprovalAuthority.UserID = Aspnet_Users.UserID left join aspnet_users LastApproval on LastApproval.UserID = SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedBy inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 -- AND {1} Order By data.name: Query_DispatchDocument
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SerialNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as DocumentNo, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] as DocumentDate, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID], [SET_Location].[LocationName], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[ToLocationID], ToLocation.LocationName TolocationName ,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Comments], [INV_Item].[Description] as ItemDescription, [INV_Item].[InventoryItemStatusCode], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].ActualReceivedQuantity AS ActualReceivedQuantity, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionCost], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Amount], INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 5 then 'InProcess' when 5 then 'InProcess' when 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when 1 then 'Approved' else '' end as ApproveStatus,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName ,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodName as PaymentMethod ,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue
FROM [INV_StockTransactionDetail]
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIn SAL_DispatchHeader On SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND --SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceDocumentTypeID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceCode AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID] AND --[INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionUOMID]
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] and [SET_Location].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN [SET_Location] ToLocation ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].ToLocationID = ToLocation.[LocationID] and [SET_Location].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [INV_Item].ItemTypeID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = [INV_Item].ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And --LEFT JOIN SET_ReceiptMethod ON SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodID=[INV_StockTransactionHeader].re LEFt JOIN SET_ReceiptMethod on SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PaymentType
WHERE [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID=@CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID=@PeriodID

,SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID as CatalogID , SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName ,case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 5 then 'InProcess' when 5 then 'InProcess' when 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when 1 then 'Approved' else '' end as ApproveStatus ,isnull(case when Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost=0 then Inv_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate else Inv_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost end,0) Rate ,CustomDuty,OtherCharges,SalesTax as TaxAmount,CurrencyConversionDate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID,ShipmentNumber ,0 as TaxPercent,0 as CustomDutyPercent , 0 as OtherChargesPercent,ISNULL(NetAmount,0) as NetAmount , case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate is not null and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate != 0 then (ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount,0) / INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyConversionRate) else 0 end as ContainerSize ,ISNULL(NetAmount,0) as CMTAmount, Inv_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode as RecipeNo ,ISNUll(CustomDuty,0) as CDAmount ,ISNUll(OtherCharges,0) as AdditionalAmount, isnull((INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdatedByValue),INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedByValue) as PreparedBy ,Case When INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode=1 then isnull(( select top 1 CreatedByValue from SET_DocumentApprove where Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and Set_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID order by DocumentApproveID desc ),INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedByValue) else '' end as ApprovedBy, (case when INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdatedByValue is null then INV_StockTransactionHeader.CreatedByValue else INV_StockTransactionHeader.UpdatedByValue end) as PreParedBy ,SET_DocumentApprove.CreatedByValue as ApprovedBy, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftID, HRMS_Set_Shift.Description as ShiftName ,SET_Rack.RackID,RackName,StrikeNo,SerialNoFrom,SerialNoTO ,case when ShiftingThroughID = 1 then 'ConveyorBelt' when ShiftingThroughID = 2 then 'TwoWheel' when ShiftingThroughID = 3 then 'Tractor' else '' end as ShiftingThrough,ShiftingThroughID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID ,Case INV_StockTransactionDetail.GrainSizeID When 1 then 'Medium' When 2 then 'Bold' When 3 then 'Fine' else '' end AS GrainSizeName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID ,Case INV_StockTransactionDetail.PackTypeID When 1 then 'With_InnerLiner' When 2 then 'Without_InnerLiner' else '' end AS PackingName ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShortLength ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.Tail,INV_StockTransactionDetail.OverWeight,INV_StockTransactionDetail.Defected
from INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID left join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = Item.ItemCatalogGroupID Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID
and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID --and Item.CompanyID = INV_SET_Category.CompanyID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN FA_AssetIdentity on FA_AssetIdentity.AssetIdentityID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND FA_AssetIdentity.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 Left JOIN SET_Rack On SET_Rack.RackID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID AND SET_Rack.Status=1 left join INV_Item EndProduct on EndProduct.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FinishingItemID left join SET_ItemCatalog EndCatalog on EndCatalog.ItemCatalogID = EndProduct.ItemCatalogGroupID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category EndCategory ON EndProduct.ItemTypeID = EndCategory.CategoryID and EndProduct.CompanyID = EndCategory.CompanyID
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ClearingAgent ON ClearingAgent.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ClearingAgentID AND ClearingAgent.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_CostCenter CostCenterTo On CostCenterTo.CostCenterID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo AND CostCenterTo.Status = 1
Left Join SET_DocumentApprove on SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus='Approved' AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status = 1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentApproveID = (SELECT TOP 1 DA.DocumentApproveID FROM SET_DocumentApprove DA WHERE DA.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID AND DA.DocumentNo = SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo AND DA.FiscalID = SET_DocumentApprove.FiscalID AND DA.ApprovalStatus = SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus ORDER BY DA.DocumentApproveID desc ) Left Join HRMS_Set_Shift on HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftID and HRMS_Set_Shift.Status=1 Where (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNO= @DocumentNo OR @DocumentNo is null) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID ANd INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=@PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1

LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer LogisticSupplier ON LogisticSupplier.CustomerID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.LogisticSupplierID AND LogisticSupplier.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ClearingAgent ON ClearingAgent.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ClearingAgentID AND ClearingAgent.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_CostCenter CostCenterTo On CostCenterTo.CostCenterID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo AND CostCenterTo.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Location ToLocation On ToLocation.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID And Set_Location.Status = 1
Where (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNO= @DocumentNo OR @DocumentNo is null) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID ANd INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=@PeriodID
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1

data.name: Query_GetStockReportDepartmetnWise
data.value:
select @FromDate as FromDate,@TODate as AsOnDate,CodeCombinationID, AccountCodeDescription,CategoryName, sum(OpeningQty) as OpeningQty, sum(OpeningAmount) as OpeningAmount, sum(TransferINQty) as TransferINQty, sum(TransferINAmount) as TransferINAmount, sum(StockReturnTransferQty) as StockReturnTransferQty, sum(StockReturnTransferAmount) as StockReturnTransferAmount, sum(TransferQty) as TransferQty, sum(TransferAmount) as TransferAmount ,DepartmentName,ISNULL(IncurredON,'Undefine')IncurredON,ISNULL(JobDescription,'Repair & Maintenance')JobDescription,CostCenterID,ISNULL(CostCenterName,'Undefine')CostCenterName ,ISNULL(JobID,0)JobID,IncurredOnID,DepartmentID, tab.CompanyName, tab.LogoImage from ( Select GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as AccountCodeDescription, SET_ItemCatalog.Description CategoryName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, std.TransactionCost, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, (case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact = 'Negative' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact = 'Positive' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) end End) as OpeningQty, (case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact='Positive' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) end End)* std.TransactionCost --(case when std.TransactionQuantity > 0 then std.TransactionCost else ISNULL(std.AverageRate,std.TransactionCost) -- END) as OpeningAmount, 0 AS TransferINQty, 0 AS TransferINAmount, 0 as StockReturnTransferQty, 0 as StockReturnTransferAmount, 0 AS TransferQty, 0 AS TransferAmount, sth.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, Inv_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID ,sth .DocumentNo,returndept.DepartmentName as ReturnDepartment ,SET_Department.DepartmentName,INV_Incurred.Description as IncurredON,std.JobID,Set_Job.JobDescription ,sth.CostCenterID,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,sth.IncurredOnID,sth.DepartmentID, (SET_Business.BusinessName +'-' +SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName) as CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.LogoImage From INV_StockTransactionHeader sth INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail std ON std.StockTransactionID = sth.StockTransactionID AND std.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND std.Status = 1 Inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].TransactionImpact != 'No Impact'
and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GIn on GIN.StockTransactionID = std.SourceHeaderID and GIN.DocumentTypeID = std.SourceDocumentTypeID and GIN.CompanyID = std.CompanyID and GIN.PeriodID = std.PeriodID and GIN.FiscalID= std.FiscalID INNER JOIN INV_ITem On INV_ITem.ItemID = std.ITemID --AND INV_ITem.CompanyID = std.CompanyID Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = std.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter returncostcenter ON returncostcenter.CostCenterID = GIN.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = sth.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN SET_Department returndept ON returndept.DepartmentID = GIN.DepartmentID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.CodeCombinationID Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID =std.JobID and Set_Job.CompanyID = std.CompanyID
left join INV_Item INV_Incurred on INV_Incurred.ItemID = std.IncurredOnID inner join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=sth.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1
WHERE sth.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.DocumentDate < @FromDate and [SET_DocumentType].menuID not in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx')) --and SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID in (39,53,54,114,128,129,8, 12, 40, 64, 83, 106,19, 28, 59, 94, 155) {0} {1}
union all
Select GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as AccountCodeDescription, SET_ItemCatalog.Description CategoryName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, std.TransactionCost, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit,
0 as OpeningQty, 0 as OpeningAmount,
case when TransactionImpact='Positive' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%Stock%Return%' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) else 0 end AS TransferINQty, case when TransactionImpact='Positive' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%Stock%Return%' then abs((std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * std.TransactionCost) else 0 end AS TransferINAmount,
case when TransactionImpact='Positive' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Stock%Return%' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) else 0 end AS StockReturnTransferQty, case when TransactionImpact='Positive' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Stock%Return%' then abs((std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * std.TransactionCost) else 0 end AS StockReturnTransferAmount,
case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) else 0 end AS TransferQty, case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs((std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * std.TransactionCost) else 0 end AS TransferAmount,
sth.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, Inv_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID ,sth .DocumentNo ,returndept.DepartmentName as ReturnDepartment ,SET_Department.DepartmentName,INV_Incurred.Description as IncurredON ,std.JobID,Set_Job.JobDescription ,sth.CostCenterID,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,sth.IncurredOnID,sth.DepartmentID, (SET_Business.BusinessName +'-' +SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName) as CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.LogoImage From INV_StockTransactionHeader sth INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail std ON std.StockTransactionID = sth.StockTransactionID AND std.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND std.Status = 1
Inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].TransactionImpact != 'No Impact'
and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GIn on GIN.StockTransactionID = std.SourceHeaderID and GIN.DocumentTypeID = std.SourceDocumentTypeID and GIN.CompanyID = std.CompanyID and GIN.PeriodID = std.PeriodID and GIN.FiscalID= std.FiscalID INNER JOIN INV_ITem On INV_ITem.ItemID = std.ITemID --AND INV_ITem.CompanyID = std.CompanyID Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = std.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter returncostcenter ON returncostcenter.CostCenterID = GIN.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = sth.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN SET_Department returndept ON returndept.DepartmentID = GIN.DepartmentID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID
Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.CodeCombinationID Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID =std.JobID and Set_Job.CompanyID = std.CompanyID
left join INV_Item INV_Incurred on INV_Incurred.ItemID = std.IncurredOnID inner join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=sth.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1
WHERE sth.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and [SET_DocumentType].menuID not in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx')) {0} {1} )as tab group by CodeCombinationID,AccountCodeDescription,CategoryName,DepartmentName,IncurredON,JobDescription,CostCenterID,CostCenterName,JobID,IncurredOnID,DepartmentID , tab.CompanyName, tab.LogoImage

data.name: Query_IssuanceReport
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SerialNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo as DocumentNo, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentDate] as DocumentDate, [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID], [SET_Location].[LocationName], [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[ToLocationID], ToLocation.LocationName TolocationName ,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Comments], [INV_Item].[Description] as ItemDescription, [INV_Item].[InventoryItemStatusCode], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].ActualReceivedQuantity AS ActualReceivedQuantity, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionCost], [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Amount], INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,case INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode when 5 then 'InProcess' when 5 then 'InProcess' when 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when 1 then 'Approved' else '' end as ApproveStatus,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName ,[INV_StockTransactionHeader].CreatedByValue
FROM [INV_StockTransactionDetail]
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[ItemID] AND --[INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionUOMID]
INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] and [SET_Location].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN [SET_Location] ToLocation ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].ToLocationID = ToLocation.[LocationID] and [SET_Location].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [INV_Item].ItemTypeID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = [INV_Item].ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID AND WHERE [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID=@CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID=@PeriodID

data.name: Query_ItemStockStatusTwo
data.value:
Select @FromDate as FromDate,@TODate as AsOnDate,CategoryID,CategoryName,ItemID,ItemDescription,InventoryItemStatusCode as PartNo,UOMName,UnitPrice ,SUM(Open_TransactionQuantity) as OpeningQty,SUM(Open_TransactionCost) as OpeningCost ,SUM(OpeningAmount) as OpeningAmount ,SUM(SalesQty) as SalesQty ,AVG(SalesCost) as SalseCost ,SUM(SalesAmount) as SalesAmount ,SUM(PurchaseQty) as PurchaseQty ,SUM(PurchaseCost) as PurchaseCost ,SUM(PurchaseAmount) as PurchaseAmount ,SUM(TransferQty) as TransferQty ,SUM(TransferCost) as TransferCost ,SUM(TransferAmount) as TransferAmount ,SUM(SalesReturnQty) as SalesReturnQty ,SUM(SalesReturnCost) as SalesReturnCost ,SUM(SalesReturnAmount) as SalesReturnAmount ,SUM(TransferINQty) as TransferINQty ,SUM(TransferINCost) as TransferINCost ,SUM(TransferINAmount) as TransferINAmount
FROM ( Select CategoryID, CategoryName,ItemID ,ItemDescription, UOMName, SUM(Open_TransactionQuantity) as Open_TransactionQuantity, --(CASE WHEN SUM(Open_TransactionQuantity)<>0 then SUM(OpeningAmount)/SUM(Open_TransactionQuantity) ELSE -- 0 end) as Open_TransactionCost AVG(Open_TransactionCost) as Open_TransactionCost ,SUM(OpeningAmount) as OpeningAmount,
0 as SalesQty ,0 as SalesCost ,0 as SalesAmount ,0 as PurchaseQty ,0 as PurchaseCost ,0 as PurchaseAmount ,0 as TransferQty ,0 as TransferCost ,0 as TransferAmount ,0 as SalesReturnQty ,0 as SalesReturnCost ,0 as SalesReturnAmount ,0 as TransferINQty ,0 as TransferINCost ,0 as TransferINAmount ,UnitPrice ,'Positive' as TransactionImpact ,InventoryItemStatusCode from ( Select INV_SET_Category.CategoryID,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID , INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName
--, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity as Open_TransactionQuantity, ,(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end End) as Open_TransactionQuantity, --(case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then -- (Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) -- when (isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then -- (Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + (isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 --else --(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + (isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / (isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) --end --) (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate END)as Open_TransactionCost, (case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end End)*(case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity > 0 then INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost else INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate END) as openingAmount ,0 as SalesQty ,0 as SalesCost ,0 as SalesAmount ,0 as PurchaseQty ,0 as PurchaseCost , 0 as PurchaseAmount ,0 as TransferQty ,0 as TransferCost ,0 as TransferAmount ,0 as SalesReturnQty ,0 as SalesReturnCost ,0 as SalesReturnAmount ,0 as TransferINQty ,0 as TransferINCost ,0 as TransferINAmount ,INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit AS UnitPrice ,'opening' as TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
--LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
-- LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end) LEFT JOIN SET_Location locationDt ON locationDt.LocationID = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end) AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) AND isnull(DownloadableFlag,0) = 0 -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType != 'Transfer Out' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType != 'Transfer In' AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 -- AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL --AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID =@LocationID OR @LocationID is null) AND (isnull(locationDt.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null)
{0}
) as TAB {1}
GROUP BY CategoryID, CategoryName, ItemID, UOMName, InventoryItemStatusCode,TAB.ItemDescription,UnitPrice
UNION ALL
-------------OPENING Select * from ( SELECT Distinct INV_SET_Category.CategoryID,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID , INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) as UOMName, abs(SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) as Open_TransactionQuantity, (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end ) as Open_TransactionCost ,(case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end )* abS(SUM(TransactionQuantity)) as OpeningAmount ,0 as SalesQty ,0 as SalesCost ,0 as SalesAmount ,0 as PurchaseQty ,0 as PurchaseCost ,0 as PurchaseAmount ,0 as TransferQty ,0 as TransferCost ,0 as TransferAmount ,0 as SalesReturnQty ,0 as SalesReturnCost ,0 as SalesReturnAmount ,0 as TransferINQty ,0 as TransferINCost ,0 as TransferINAmount ,INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit AS UnitPrice ,'opening' as TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
left JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode INNER JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode
--LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
-- LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID
inner JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND ((SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Stock Adjustment') or (SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact') )
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end) LEFT JOIN SET_Location locationDt ON locationDt.LocationID = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.ToLocationID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid) ELSE INV_StockTransactionHeader.locationid end)
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) AND isnull(DownloadableFlag,0) = 0 -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType != 'Transfer Out' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType != 'Transfer In' AND DocumentType like '%Opening%' AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) between @FromDate AND @ToDate
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 -- AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL -- AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID =@LocationID OR @LocationID is null) AND (isnull(locationDt.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) {0}
GROUP BY INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_SET_Category.CategoryID ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName) , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode, INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight ,INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange ) as TAB {1}

,ABS(SUM(TransferQty)) as TransferQty ,(CASE WHEN ABS(SUM(TransferQty))>0 then abs(SUM(TransferAmount))/ABS(SUM(TransferQty))else 0 end) as TransferCost data.name: Query_MaterialConsumptionReport
data.value:
Select Item,UOMName,SUM(TransferQty)TransactionQuantity,SUM(TransferAmount)Amount,DepartmentID,DepartmentName,InventoryItemStatusCode from (
select '('+INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode +') '+INV_Item.Description as Item ,Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName ,ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ,abs((INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) Amount ,SET_Department.DepartmentID ,SET_Department.DepartmentName ,Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID ,Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName ,case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) else 0 end AS TransferQty, case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs((INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) else 0 end AS TransferAmount ,InventoryItemStatusCode
from dbo.INV_StockTransactionHeader
inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 and [SET_DocumentType].TransactionImpact != 'No Impact' and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_Item.Status = 1 Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.CodeCombinationID inner join Set_UnitOfMeasure on Set_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID and Set_UnitOfMeasure.Status = 1 and INV_Item.Status = 1
left join Set_CostCenter on Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID
left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID and SET_Department.Status = 1
Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID =INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID
left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GIn on GIN.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID and GIN.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID
LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter returncostcenter ON returncostcenter.CostCenterID = GIN.CostCenterID
LEFT JOIN SET_Department returndept ON returndept.DepartmentID = GIN.DepartmentID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID
inner join [ApplicationMenu] on [ApplicationMenu].MenuID = [SET_DocumentType].menuID
where [SET_DocumentType].menuID not in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx')) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID in (64, 12, 114,28,114, 114,28)
{0}
) as tab
group by Item,UOMName,DepartmentID,DepartmentName,InventoryItemStatusCode
Order By InventoryItemStatusCode

data.name: Query_SalesDocumentReport
data.value:
SELECT DISTINCT SAL_OrderDetail.SerialNo, [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractNo as DocumentNo, [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as DocumentDate, ----[INV_StockTransactionHeader].[LocationID], ----[SET_Location].[LocationName], ----[INV_StockTransactionHeader].[ToLocationID], ----ToLocation.LocationName TolocationName [SAL_OrderHeader].Remarks as Comments, [INV_Item].[Description] as ItemDescription, [INV_Item].[InventoryItemStatusCode], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], abs(SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity) as TransactionQuantity, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,case SAL_OrderHeader.StatusCode when 5 then 'InProcess' when 5 then 'InProcess' when 12 then 'ReleaseForApprove' when 1 then 'Approved' else '' end as ApproveStatus,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as CatalogName ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodName as PaymentMethod ,[SET_DocumentType].DocumentType ,SET_Term.Description as PaymentTerm ,SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount ,SAL_OrderDetail.NetAmount ,SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity as SOQuantity ,SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount ,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate ,SAL_OrderHeader.CreatedByValue
FROM SAL_OrderDetail INNER join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID=SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID=SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID=SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = SAL_OrderDetail.[ItemID] AND --[INV_Item].[CompanyID] = SAL_OrderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=SAL_OrderHeader.CustomerID --INNER JOIN [SET_Location] ON --SAL_OrderHeader.[LocationID] = [SET_Location].[LocationID] and --[SET_Location].[Status] = 1 -- LEFT JOIN [SET_Location] ToLocation ON --SAL_OrderHeader.ToLocationID = ToLocation.[LocationID] and --[SET_Location].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [INV_Item].ItemTypeID AND --[INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [INV_Item].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = [INV_Item].ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SET_DocumentType] ON [SAL_OrderHeader].[SaleContractTypeID] = [SET_DocumentType].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SET_DocumentType].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SET_DocumentType].[PeriodID] AND [SET_DocumentType].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID -- And LEFT JOIN SET_ReceiptMethod ON SET_ReceiptMethod.ReceiptMethodID=SAL_OrderHeader.PaymentTypeID LEFt JOIN SET_Term on SET_Term.TermID=SAL_OrderHeader.PaymentTermID
WHERE SAL_OrderDetail.[Status] = 1 AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID=@CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID=@PeriodID

select tab.Description as ItemDescription,
sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) as OpeningBalanceQty,
case when sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) = 0 then 0 else sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceRate) / sum(Tab.OpeningBalanceQty)
end as OpeningBalanceRate,
TAB.ItemID FROM (
SELECT INV_Item.Description,
(case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) else abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 end) AS OpeningBalanceQty,
((isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) * (case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 end)) + isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0) AS OpeningBalanceRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 and SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <>'No Impact' AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND (isnull(SL.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) --GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID,INV_Item.Description,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ) AS TAB group by TAB.ItemID,tab.Description
