Left Join SET_Rack reverseRack On reverseRack.RackID = SAL_ReverseDetail.RackID And reverseRack.Status = 1
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 And (INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = @ItemCategory Or @ItemCategory is null) AND (INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID = @RackID Or @RackID is null) --And (SET_Location.LocationID = @LocationID Or @LocationID is null) {0} AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.ReversalID IS NULL GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, isnull(SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,UOM.UOMName), SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID,SET_Rack.RackName,reverseRack.RackName,SAL_ReverseDetail.RackID
) as TAB {1} --order by TAB.CreateDate,TAB.DocumentType desc,TAB.Orderid desc, tab.DocumentNo ) as FinTAb --where fintab.transactionquantity <> 0 {2}
---------------------------------------------------
select tab.Description as ItemDescription,
sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) as OpeningBalanceQty,
case when sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) = 0 then 0 else sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceRate) / sum(Tab.OpeningBalanceQty)
end as OpeningBalanceRate,
TAB.ItemID FROM (
SELECT INV_Item.Description,
CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID = 1 THEN ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) WHEN INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID = 2 THEN ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 END ELSE CASE WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' THEN ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) WHEN SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Negative' THEN ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 END END AS OpeningBalanceQty,
--(case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) --else abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 end) AS OpeningBalanceQty,
((isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.AverageRate,INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost)) * (case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Negative' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * -1 end)) + isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0) AS OpeningBalanceRate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID,INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID,RackName
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Rack On SET_Rack.RackID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 and SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <>'No Impact' AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND (isnull(SL.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) AND (INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID = @RackID Or @RackID is null)
--GROUP BY INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID,INV_Item.Description,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ) AS TAB group by TAB.ItemID,tab.Description

data.name: Query_StockStatusCodeWise
data.value:
select @FromDate as FromDate,@TODate as AsOnDate,CodeCombinationID,AccountCodeDescription,CategoryName,Description as ItemDescription,ItemID,InventoryItemStatusCode as PartNo,UOMName,ListPricePerUnit
,sum(OpeningQty) as OpeningQty,sum(OpeningAmount) as OpeningAmount,sum(TransferINQty) as TransferINQty,sum(TransferINAmount) as TransferINAmount, sum(StockReturnTransferQty) as StockReturnTransferQty,sum(StockReturnTransferAmount) as StockReturnTransferAmount, sum(TransferQty) as TransferQty,sum(TransferAmount) as TransferAmount --,sum(GINQty) as GINQty,sum(GIN_Amount) as GIN_Amount ,ItemCatalog,ShelfReference
from (
Select GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as AccountCodeDescription, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,
INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,
SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, std.TransactionCost, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit,
(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else
case when TransactionImpact = 'Negative' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity)*-1
when TransactionImpact = 'Positive' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) end End) as OpeningQty,
(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact='Positive' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) end End)* std.TransactionCost --(case when std.TransactionQuantity > 0 then std.TransactionCost else ISNULL(std.AverageRate,std.TransactionCost) -- END) as OpeningAmount,
0 AS TransferINQty, 0 AS TransferINAmount,
0 as StockReturnTransferQty, 0 as StockReturnTransferAmount, 0 AS TransferQty, 0 AS TransferAmount,
sth.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, Inv_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID ,sth .DocumentNo ,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCatalog ,INV_Item.ShelfReference From INV_StockTransactionHeader sth INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail std ON std.StockTransactionID = sth.StockTransactionID AND std.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND std.Status = 1
Inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].TransactionImpact != 'No Impact'
and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GIn on GIN.StockTransactionID = std.SourceHeaderID and GIN.DocumentTypeID = std.SourceDocumentTypeID and GIN.CompanyID = std.CompanyID and GIN.PeriodID = std.PeriodID and GIN.FiscalID= std.FiscalID INNER JOIN INV_ITem On INV_ITem.ItemID = std.ITemID --AND INV_ITem.CompanyID = std.CompanyID Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = sth.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter returncostcenter ON returncostcenter.CostCenterID = GIN.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = sth.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN SET_Department returndept ON returndept.DepartmentID = GIN.DepartmentID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.CodeCombinationID Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID =std.JobID and Set_Job.CompanyID = std.CompanyID inner join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = isnull(sth.LocationID,std.LocationID)
WHERE sth.CompanyID IN @CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.DocumentDate < @FromDate and [SET_DocumentType].menuID not in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx'))
{0} {1}
union all
Select GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as AccountCodeDescription, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,
INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,
SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, std.TransactionCost, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit,
0 as OpeningQty, 0 as OpeningAmount,
case when TransactionImpact='Positive' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%Stock%Return%' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) else 0 end AS TransferINQty, case when TransactionImpact='Positive' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%Stock%Return%' then abs((std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * std.TransactionCost) else 0 end AS TransferINAmount,
case when TransactionImpact='Positive' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Stock%Return%' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) else 0 end AS StockReturnTransferQty, case when TransactionImpact='Positive' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Stock%Return%' then abs((std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * std.TransactionCost) else 0 end AS StockReturnTransferAmount,
case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) else 0 end AS TransferQty, case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs((std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * std.TransactionCost) else 0 end AS TransferAmount,
sth.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, Inv_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID ,sth .DocumentNo ,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCatalog ,INV_Item.ShelfReference From INV_StockTransactionHeader sth INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail std ON std.StockTransactionID = sth.StockTransactionID AND std.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND std.Status = 1
Inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].TransactionImpact != 'No Impact'
and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GIn on GIN.StockTransactionID = std.SourceHeaderID and GIN.DocumentTypeID = std.SourceDocumentTypeID and GIN.CompanyID = std.CompanyID and GIN.PeriodID = std.PeriodID and GIN.FiscalID= std.FiscalID INNER JOIN INV_ITem On INV_ITem.ItemID = std.ITemID --AND INV_ITem.CompanyID = std.CompanyID Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = sth.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter returncostcenter ON returncostcenter.CostCenterID = GIN.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = sth.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN SET_Department returndept ON returndept.DepartmentID = GIN.DepartmentID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.CodeCombinationID Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID =std.JobID and Set_Job.CompanyID = std.CompanyID inner join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = isnull(sth.LocationID,std.LocationID)
WHERE sth.CompanyID IN @CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and [SET_DocumentType].menuID not in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx'))
{0} {1} )as FinTAb group by CodeCombinationID,AccountCodeDescription,CategoryName,Description,ItemID,InventoryItemStatusCode,UOMName,ListPricePerUnit,ItemCatalog,ShelfReference {2} {3} {4}

--Declare @FromDate datetime = '2020-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-03-25 00:00:00:000' --Declare @PeriodID int = 1
Select t.CustomerName, SUM(t.TotalAmount) as TotalAmount, t.OperatingUnitName, t.Description from (
select Distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,GL_TransactionHeader.ControlDebit as TotalAmount,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,SET_SourceType.Description
from Set_RelatedPartyInformation
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Set_RelatedPartyInformation.NatureOfRelatedPartyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 --inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
inner join Inv_StockTransactionHeader on Inv_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID and Inv_StockTransactionHeader.Statuscode = 1 and Inv_StockTransactionHeader.status = 1
Inner join Inv_StockTransactionDetail on Inv_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID and Inv_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and Inv_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and Inv_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
Inner join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = Inv_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and Inv_Item.Status = 1
Inner join SET_SourceType on SET_SourceType.SourceTypeID = Inv_Item.SourceTypeID and SET_SourceType.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
where GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in ({0}) and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and Set_RelatedPartyInformation.Status = 1 and Set_RelatedPartyInformation.IsActive = 1 --and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = 5955 --and GL_TransactionHeader.documenttypeid = 28 )t --where t.TotalAmount != 0 group by t.CustomerName, t.OperatingUnitName, t.Description order by t.CustomerName asc

data.name: Query_SugarHandlingStorageExpenses
data.value:
--Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2020-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-09-30 00:00:00:000'
SELECT 'Sugar Produced' as Description, SUM(Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) AS result, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName as units
from INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
INNER JOIN INV_Item Item ON Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID left join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = Item.ItemCatalogGroupID Left JOIN AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON Item.ItemTypeID = INV_SET_Category.CategoryID LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID LEFT JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CurrencyID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Project ON SET_Project.ProjectID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ProjectID LEFT JOIN FA_AssetIdentity on FA_AssetIdentity.AssetIdentityID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID AND FA_AssetIdentity.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.LocationID and SET_Location.Status = 1 Left JOIN SET_Rack On SET_Rack.RackID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.RackID AND SET_Rack.Status=1 left join INV_Item EndProduct on EndProduct.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FinishingItemID left join SET_ItemCatalog EndCatalog on EndCatalog.ItemCatalogID = EndProduct.ItemCatalogGroupID LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category EndCategory ON EndProduct.ItemTypeID = EndCategory.CategoryID and EndProduct.CompanyID = EndCategory.CompanyID
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ClearingAgent ON ClearingAgent.CustomerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.ClearingAgentID AND ClearingAgent.Status = 1 Left Join Set_Department On Set_Department.DepartmentID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DepartmentID And Set_Department.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_CostCenter CostCenterTo On CostCenterTo.CostCenterID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CostCenterIDTo AND CostCenterTo.Status = 1
Left Join SET_DocumentApprove on SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus='Approved' Left Join HRMS_Set_Shift on HRMS_Set_Shift.ShiftID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.ShiftID and HRMS_Set_Shift.Status=1
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
Where SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Finish Goods - Sugar' AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID ANd INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 group by SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName
-----------------------------------------
select 'Sugar handling & storage expenses' as Description , SUM((case when GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else GL_TransactionDetail.Amount * -1 end)) as result ,'Rupees' as units from GL_TransactionDetail left join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID
where GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and (GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID like '08-01-03-001-%' and LOWER(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description) not like '%loading%') and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
--group by SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName
----------------------------------------
select GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description , SUM((case when GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else GL_TransactionDetail.Amount * -1 end)) as result ,'Rupees' as units from GL_TransactionDetail left join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID
where GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and (GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID like '08-01-03-001-%' and LOWER(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description) not like '%loading%') and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
group by --SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description
-----------------------------------------
Select Count(HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID) as NoOFEmployees , (datediff(month, @FromDate, @ToDate) + 1) as NoOfMonths ,(Count(HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID) / (datediff(month, @FromDate, @ToDate) + 1)) as AvgMonthlyWorkers
from HRMS_SET_Employee Inner JOin HRMS_SalaryHeader on HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID=HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.PersonID = HRMS_SET_Employee.PersonID AND HRMS_SalaryHeader.Status=1 AND HRMS_SET_Employee.IsActive=1 AND HRMS_SET_Employee.Status=1
inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = HRMS_SalaryHeader.CompanyID
where HRMS_SET_Employee.StatusID in (Select StatusID from HRMS_Employement_Status where Description like '%Daily Wages%' and Status = 1) and HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID in @CompanyID and HRMS_SalaryHeader.SalaryDate between @FromDate and @ToDate

--where GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID --and LOWER(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description) like 'empty bags shifting to bagging area%' --and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @FromDate --and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID

data.name: Query_SummaryOfCWIP
data.value:
--Declare @FromDate datetime = '2021-03-04 00:00:00:000' --Declare @PeriodID int = 1
select SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName , SUM((case when GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else GL_TransactionDetail.Amount * -1 end)) as TotalAmount , GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description from GL_TransactionDetail left join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 left join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID left join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
where GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID
and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID like '%03-01-05-%'
and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @FromDate
group by SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description
order by GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description asc

--Declare @FromDate datetime = '2020-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-03-30 00:00:00:000' --Declare @PeriodID int = 1
select RelatedParty.CustomerName, Set_RelatedPartyInformation.DirectorHolding as HoldingPercentage , Set_RelatedPartyInformation.DirectorName ,(case when Set_RelatedPartyInformation.Nature = 1 then 'Related Party' when Set_RelatedPartyInformation.Nature = 2 then 'Associate Company' when Set_RelatedPartyInformation.Nature = 3 then 'Subsidiary Company' else '' end ) as Nature ,'' as Description, '' as CodeCombinationID ,(
select SUM(Final.debit) - SUM(Final.credit) from ( select DocumentDate,tab.CreateDate,tab.CompanyID,DocumentType,DocumentTypeID ,CostCenterName ,tab.CustomerID ,case when HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode is null then tab.CustomerName else tab.CustomerName + ' (' + HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode + ')' end as CustomerName ,DocumentNo ,debit ,credit ,InstrumentNo ,Comments ,CodeCombinationID ,CodeDescription ,InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO ,(Select OperatingUnitName from SET_OperatingUnit where OperatingUnitId = tab.CompanyID) as UnitName from ( select @FromDate AS DocumentDate,@FromDate AS CreateDate,CompanyID, 'Opening' AS DocumentType,0 AS DocumentTypeID,'' as CostCenterName, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.CustomerName,null as DocumentNo,
Abs(Sum(Debit)) debit,
Sum(credit) as credit,'' as InstrumentNo,'' as Comments, CodeCombinationID CodeCombinationID,CodeDescription ,'' as InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
from ( SELECT 'Opening' as DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Comments, FinTab.CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO FROM ( Select distinct OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, Sum(OpeningTAB.Debit) As Debit, Sum(OpeningTAB.Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description As Comments, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID ,OpeningTAB.CodeDescription,OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber From ( --------------- Sale Inovice Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalID is null and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and isnull(GL_TransactionHeader.IsReversed,0) = 0 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate -- and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) -- And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID
) As OpeningTAB Group By OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID , OpeningTAB.CodeDescription, OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber
UNION ALL ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate -- and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) -- And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
UNION ALL ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- OPENING Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, '' as CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber From Sal_InvoiceHeader
Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode
inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode Where Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate -- and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) -- And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' and AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber

) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber

INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 Inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = IMP_CustomClearing.ClearingAgentID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = IMP_CustomClearing.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Service_Providers'
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID WHERE IMP_CustomClearing.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND IMP_CustomClearing.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND IMP_CustomClearing.Createdate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
--and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) --And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode, FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
union all
---------- Shipment Transportation ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, Fintab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode As CodeCombinationID, FinTab.CodeDescription ,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, '' as PaymentServerOrderNo, ' ' as Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as SupplierAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit, GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,'' AS InstrumentNo ,'' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO FROM Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = (select top 1 DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType doctype where doctype.DocumentType = 'Transportation' and doctype.CompanyID = Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.CompanyID ) and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.TransporterID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.ContainerTransportationID and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 Inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.TransporterID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Vendor'
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID WHERE Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND Set_ContainerTransportationandUnloading.Createdate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
-- and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) --And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode, FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
union all
---------- Direct LC Expense ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, Fintab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode As CodeCombinationID, FinTab.CodeDescription ,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, '' as PaymentServerOrderNo, ' ' as Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as SupplierAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit, GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,'' AS InstrumentNo ,'' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO FROM DirectLcExpense_Header INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = DirectLcExpense_Header.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = DirectLcExpense_Header.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = (select top 1 DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType doctype where doctype.DocumentType = 'LC Direct Expenses' and doctype.CompanyID = DirectLcExpense_Header.CompanyID ) and DirectLcExpense_Header.status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON DirectLcExpense_Header.ClearingAgentID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND DirectLcExpense_Header.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = DirectLcExpense_Header.CustomClearingID and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and DirectLcExpense_Header.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 Inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = DirectLcExpense_Header.ClearingAgentID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = DirectLcExpense_Header.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Vendor'
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID WHERE DirectLcExpense_Header.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND DirectLcExpense_Header.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND DirectLcExpense_Header.Createdate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
--and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) --And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) And (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID Or RelatedParty.CustomerID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode, FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
Union ALL
---------- Purchase Return ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, Fintab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode As CodeCombinationID, FinTab.CodeDescription ,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, '' as PaymentServerOrderNo, ' ' as Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as SupplierAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit, GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,'' AS InstrumentNo ,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumber ,STUFF(( select distinct ', ' + convert(varchar(10),INV_StockTransactionheader.DocumentNo) from INV_StockTransactionDetail inner join INV_StockTransactionheader on INV_StockTransactionheader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionheader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionheader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID inner join AR_InvoiceDetail invDtl on invDtl.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and invDtl.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and invDtl.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and invDtl.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and invDtl.Status = 1 where INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and invDtl.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and invDtl.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and invDtl.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS GRN_NO ,STUFF(( Select distinct ', ' + convert(varchar(10), AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber) from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader left join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 Where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS PO_NO
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 Inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
----------------------
inner JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1
----------------------
WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
--and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) --And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) And (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID Or RelatedParty.CustomerID is null) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID is not null and INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID is not null and AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode, FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
)as tab Left Join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_CustomerID = tab.CustomerID AND HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID in @CompanyID
)Final where Final.CustomerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID ) as TotalAmount ,0 as OpeningBalance from Set_RelatedPartyInformation left join AR_SET_Customer as RelatedParty on RelatedParty.CustomerID = Set_RelatedPartyInformation.NatureOfRelatedPartyID and RelatedParty.Status = 1 left join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID left join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode left join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 left join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 left join SET_AccountType on SET_AccountType.AccountTypeID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID and SET_AccountType.Status = 1 left join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
where GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and Set_RelatedPartyInformation.Status = 1 and Set_RelatedPartyInformation.IsActive = 1
group by RelatedParty.CustomerName,Set_RelatedPartyInformation.DirectorHolding,Set_RelatedPartyInformation.DirectorName , RelatedParty.CustomerID ,Set_RelatedPartyInformation.Nature
order by RelatedParty.CustomerName asc

data.name: Query_SummaryOfRelatedPartyTransactionsReport
data.value:
--Declare @FromDate datetime = '2020-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-03-30 00:00:00:000' --Declare @PeriodID int = 1
select RelatedParty.CustomerName, Set_RelatedPartyInformation.DirectorHolding as HoldingPercentage , Set_RelatedPartyInformation.DirectorName ,(case when Set_RelatedPartyInformation.Nature = 1 then 'Related Party' when Set_RelatedPartyInformation.Nature = 2 then 'Associate Company' when Set_RelatedPartyInformation.Nature = 3 then 'Subsidiary Company' else '' end ) as Nature , GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID ,Isnull((
select SUM(Final.debit) - SUM(Final.credit) from ( select DocumentDate,tab.CreateDate,tab.CompanyID,DocumentType,DocumentTypeID ,CostCenterName ,tab.CustomerID ,case when HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode is null then tab.CustomerName else tab.CustomerName + ' (' + HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode + ')' end as CustomerName ,DocumentNo ,debit ,credit ,InstrumentNo ,Comments ,CodeCombinationID ,CodeDescription ,InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO ,(Select OperatingUnitName from SET_OperatingUnit where OperatingUnitId = tab.CompanyID) as UnitName from ( select @FromDate AS DocumentDate,@FromDate AS CreateDate,CompanyID, 'Opening' AS DocumentType,0 AS DocumentTypeID,'' as CostCenterName, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.CustomerName,null as DocumentNo,
Abs(Sum(Debit)) debit,
Sum(credit) as credit,'' as InstrumentNo,'' as Comments, CodeCombinationID CodeCombinationID,CodeDescription ,'' as InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
from ( SELECT 'Opening' as DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Comments, FinTab.CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO FROM ( Select distinct OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, Sum(OpeningTAB.Debit) As Debit, Sum(OpeningTAB.Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description As Comments, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID ,OpeningTAB.CodeDescription,OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber From ( --------------- Sale Inovice Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalID is null and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and isnull(GL_TransactionHeader.IsReversed,0) = 0 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate -- and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) -- And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID
) As OpeningTAB Group By OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID , OpeningTAB.CodeDescription, OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber
UNION ALL ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate -- and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) -- And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber

Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1

--Left Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID=AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID=AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID=AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AP_PaymentHeader.documentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType ='Debit' AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = (SELECT Max(DefaultAccountCode) FROM dbo.SET_DocumentType WHERE (DocumentType like 'Advance Against PO%') AND (CompanyID in @CompanyID) AND (PeriodID = @PeriodID) And DefaultAccountCode is not null)) AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit')
left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate And AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments is null --AND (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) --And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and isnull(GL_TransactionDetail.Narration,'') not like '%GST%' and AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = RelatedParty.CustomerID
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
union all

INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'International Vendor'
